The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping…

people.name: Baal-zephon
people.line: Egyptian location where the Israelites camped before crossing the Red Sea.

people.name: Etham
people.line: Wilderness area where Israelites camped during the Exodus

people.name: Migdol
people.line: A place near the Red Sea where the Israelites camped

people.name: Pi-hahiroth
people.line: A place near the Red Sea crossing

translations.web: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.
translations.bsb: They set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon, and they camped near Migdol.
translations.kjv: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Etham, and turned back unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.
